exposure: Fetal brain development (in situ and in tissue culture)
cohort: Pregnant Wistar rats and their fetuses were used to study the developing cerebral cortex.
finding: The presence of serotonergic cells and other elements of the serotonergic system in the early cerebral cortex was confirmed, potentially participating in cortical maturation processes during brain development.
cross-section timing: Gestational days 13, 16, and 17 for in situ observation; day 12 of culture for neopallium cocultures.
gest_age: Gestational days 13, 16, and 17 for fetuses; day 12 for tissue culture.
